proof_body:
by
  intro ω h
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re h
  have him := congrArg Complex.im h
  simp [pow_two] at hre him
  have hy : ω.im ≠ 0 := by
    intro hy
    rw [hy] at hre
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ω.re + 1 / 2)]
  have hx : ω.re = -1 / 2 := by
    have h2 : ω.im * (2 * ω.re + 1) = 0 := by linarith
    have h3 := (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left hy
    linarith
  have hsq : ω ^ 2 = -1 - ω := by linear_combination h
  have hconj : (starRingEnd ℂ) ω = ω ^ 2 := by
    rw [hsq]
    apply Complex.ext
    · simp [hx]; norm_num
    · simp
  refine ⟨hconj, ?_⟩
  rw [hconj]
  linear_combination (ω - 1) * h
target_source: ∀ ω : ℂ, ω ^ 2 + ω + 1 = 0 → (starRingEnd ℂ) ω = ω ^ 2 ∧ ω * (starRingEnd ℂ) ω = 1
